input: Research paid parental leave policies at my company

gold.taskTitle: Research paid parental leave at your company
gold.taskDescription: Investigate and understand the paid parental leave policies available at the user's current employer.

questions.title: Are you expecting a child or planning ahead?
questions.description: Understand whether this research is urgently tied to an upcoming event or is exploratory.

questions.title: Which parent role applies to you — birth, non-birth, or adoptive?
questions.description: Identify the parental category to focus the research on the most relevant policy sections.

questions.title: Do you know where your company stores HR policy documents?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a starting point such as an internal portal, handbook, or HR contact.

questions.title: What is the one thing you most want to find out?
questions.description: Pinpoint the user's primary question, such as duration, pay percentage, eligibility, or job protection.

questions.title: How long have you been at this company?
questions.description: Tenure can affect eligibility for certain leave benefits, so this shapes which policy details matter most.

questions.title: Are you a full-time, part-time, or contract employee?
questions.description: Employment type often determines which leave benefits apply, narrowing the scope of research.

questions.title: Do you need to compare this policy against any legal minimums?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user also wants to understand federal, state, or local leave laws alongside the company policy.
